value.title: SSC Combined Hindi Translators JHT Answer Key 2026
value.html:
SSC Combined Hindi Translators JHT Answer Key 2026

Post Date: September 22, 2026

10:41 am

Staff Selection Commission (SSC) has released the Answer Key on its official website for the Junior Hindi Translator, Senior Hindi Translator Examination 2026. The exam was conducted on 08 September 2026. and the last date to submit the application form was 14 May 2026. Candidates can also check their Answer Key by using their Enrollment Number, Registration Number, or Date of Birth by logging into the portal. The direct link is provided below.

SSC Combined Hindi Translators JHT Answer Key 2026

SSC JHT Examination 2026 : Short Details

SarkariResult.com.cm

Important Dates

  • Online Apply Start Date : 23 April 2026
  • Online Apply Last Date : 14 May 2026
  • Last Date For Fee Payment : 15 May 2026
  • Correction Date : 19 – 20 May 2026
  • Exam Date : 08 September 2026
  • Exam City Details : 31 August 2026
  • Admit Card : 05 September 2026
  • Answer Key : 21 September 2026 Available Now
  • Result Date : Will Be Updated Here Soon
  • Candidates are advised to confirm from the SSC official website.

Application Fee

  • For General/ OBC/ EWS : ₹ 100/-
  • For SC/ ST/ Female : ₹ 0/-
  • For PH Candidates : ₹ 0/-
  • Payment Mode (Online): You can make the payment using the following methods:
    • Debit Card
    • Credit Card
    • Internet Banking
    • IMPS
    • Cash Card / Mobile Wallet
SSC JHT Notification 2026 : Age Limits As On 01 August 2026
  • Minimum Age : 18 Years
  • Maximum Age : 30 Years 
  • SSC provides age relaxation for the Junior Hindi Translator, Senior Hindi Translator position as per their regulations.
Total Post
303 Posts
SSC JHT Recruitment 2026 : Vacancy Details
Post Name Eligibility Criteria
JHT / JTO / JT
  • Candidates must have a Master’s Degree in Hindi or English from a recognized university. In addition, they should have either a Diploma in Translation (Hindi–English) or relevant experience in translation work.
SHT / STO
  • Candidates must have a Master’s Degree from a recognized university along with a minimum of three years of experience in translation work.
  • You May Also Check : CRPF Constable Tradesman Recruitment 2026
 How To Check & Download SSC Combined Hindi Translators JHT Answer Key 2026 
  • Visit the official SSC website.
  • Go to the Examination Calendar / Latest Notices section.
  • Find the Combined Hindi Translators Examination (JHT) 2026 notice.
  • Click on the Answer Key link.
  • The exam answer key will appear on the screen.
  • Download and save the answer key for future reference.
 SSC JHT Recruitment 2026 : Mode Of Selection 
  • Paper-I CBT
  • Paper-II Descriptive
  • Document Verification

 SSC Combined Hindi Translators JHT Answer Key 2026 : Important Question 
  • Question: When will the SSC Combined Hindi Translators JHT Exam 2026 be conducted?
  • Answer: The SSC JHT 2026 examination schedule will be announced by SSC through its official website. The examination schedule is tentative and any changes will be notified on the SSC website.
  • Question: How can I check the SSC JHT Exam Date 2026?
  • Answer: Candidates can check the exam date by visiting the official SSC website and checking the latest examination notices or the JHT examination section.
  • Question: Where can I download the SSC JHT Exam Date 2026 notice?
  • Answer: Candidates can download the exam schedule from the official SSC website once it is released.
  • Question: When will the SSC JHT Exam City details be available?
  • Answer: SSC states that information regarding the examination timetable and City/Centre is uploaded on the Commission’s website about 10 days before the examination.
  • Question: What is the official website for SSC?
  • Answer: The official website for SSC is https://ssc.gov.in/
